factual_narrative: Purchased vehicle on hire which was subsequently stolen by armed hijackers. Insurance company rejected entire claim on the ground that private vehicle was used for commercial hire.
Housing board failed to deliver flat possession within 3 years despite full payment. Flat allotment delayed indefinitely with arbitrary price escalation.
Police arrested citizen without stating grounds of arrest or informing family members. Remand order passed routinely under Section 498A without Section 41 notice.
Cheque returned by bank with memo funds insufficient. Statutory demand notice issued within 30 days under Section 138 of Negotiable Instruments Act but drawer failed to pay.
Fatal motor vehicle collision causing death of self-employed victim aged 32 years. Tribunal failed to add future prospects and used wrong multiplier.
Police arrested blogger under Section 66A for posting offensive comments online criticizing state government policies.
Student applied under Right to Information Act seeking inspection and certified copies of evaluated examination answer sheets from examination board.
Unregistered lease agreement for period of 5 years. Landlord seeking eviction and tenant arguing statutory tenancy created by monthly rent acceptance.
Government authority enacted surveillance and biometric data collection violating personal liberty and privacy without valid statutory procedure under Article 21.
Citizens detained under MISA during emergency seeking writ of habeas corpus challenging executive detention without trial under Article 359.
Medical treatment in government or private hospital alleging medical negligence and deficiency of service under Consumer Protection Act.
Builder inserted one-sided clauses in builder buyer agreement and delayed possession of apartment for over 3 years.
Custodial violence and death in police custody. Arresting police officer did not prepare memo of arrest or inform relative of arrestee.
Arrest without warrant in offence punishable with imprisonment up to 7 years. Police officer must serve notice of appearance under Section 41A.
Accused admitted signature on cheque but claimed blank cheque was handed over as security. Reverse burden of proof under Section 139 NI Act.
Notice of demand returned unclaimed with postal endorsement. Notice dispatched to correct address deemed served under Section 27 General Clauses Act.
Standardization of compensation in fatal motor accident claims under Section 166. Future prospects addition for fixed salary deceased.
Online posting of defamatory and obscene messages against woman in cyber chat group without consent under Section 67 Information Technology Act.
Third party applicant seeking certified copies of judicial records and proceedings from High Court registry under RTI Act.
Conflict between Hindi text and English translation of Bihar state legislative act under Article 348(3) of Constitution.
Fundamental right to privacy declared intrinsic part of Article 21 right to life and personal liberty by nine-judge Constitution Bench.
Passport impounded by regional passport officer without post-decisional hearing. Procedure established by law under Article 21 must be just, fair and reasonable.
Mandatory registration of FIR by police officer under Section 154 CrPC upon receiving information disclosing commission of cognizable offence.
Constitutional validity of administrative tribunals excluding jurisdiction of High Courts under Articles 226 and 227. Judicial review is basic structure.
Suspension of fundamental rights under Article 359 argued to extinguish citizen locus standi to question illegal executive detention under MISA.
